stories.headline: Houthis strike Riyadh tower a second time
stories.summary: Eleven people are hurt in a second attack in under a week on the Saudi capital's tallest skyscraper, as the US warns Americans in the region of a higher threat.

stories.headline: Shenzhou-24 carries first foreign astronaut
stories.summary: China launches Shenzhou-24 to its space station with a Pakistani national aboard, the first foreign astronaut to fly on the station.

stories.headline: US jury convicts Huawei
stories.summary: A US jury convicts the Chinese tech giant in a sprawling criminal trial over its Iran business and trade secrets.

stories.headline: Shein to pay $100M in US settlement
stories.summary: The fast-fashion retailer agrees to pay $100 million to settle US trade allegations over deceptive practices.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Huang apologises, says he is in therapy
stories.summary: Nvidia chief Jensen Huang apologises to staff and says he is in therapy, as Trump says a pardon is 'always an option'.

stories.headline: Gunmen hold hostages in supermarket raid
stories.summary: Gunmen seize hostages at a Colombian supermarket after a failed armoured-car raid; 25 hostages are reported.
